headlines.description: Roberto Mancini's second spell in charge of Italy ended in a chastening 2-0 Nations League defeat in Rome as Belgium earned a deserved win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mancini's Italy return starts with Belgium defeat

headlines.description: Zinedine Zidane's first game at the helm of France resulted in a 1-0 victory over Turkey as Kylian Mbappé supplied the only goal of the Nations League fixture before promptly being replaced due to injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mbappé injury overshadows Zidane's 1st France win

headlines.description: The Socceroos have let slip a famous victory over Brazil, conceding a goal to the five-time world champions in the final minute and having to settle for a 1-1 draw in Townsville.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Brazil equaliser cancels out Irankunda's stunning strike
